meta.name: documenting-dbt-models
meta.description:
Documents dbt models and columns in schema.yml. Use when working with dbt documentation for:
(1) Adding model descriptions or column definitions to schema.yml
(2) Task mentions "document", "describe", "description", "dbt docs", or "schema.yml"
(3) Explaining business context, grain, meaning of data, or business rules
(4) Preparing dbt docs generate or improving model discoverability
Matches existing project documentation style and conventions before writing.

copy.tagline: 为 dbt 模型和字段自动生成 schema.yml 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 dbt 做数据建模并需要维护 schema.yml 文档
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate schema.yml documentation for dbt models and columns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly use dbt for data modeling and need to maintain schema.yml documentation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你为 dbt 模型和列编写 schema.yml 文档，包括描述、业务规则、粒度等，并自动匹配项目已有的文档风格。
howto.when: 当你提到“document”、“describe”、“description”、“dbt docs”或“schema.yml”，或者要求解释业务上下文、粒度、数据含义、业务规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 orders 模型写 schema.yml 文档。
say.note: Claude 会先研究项目现有文档风格，然后生成描述。

say.text: 描述 revenue 列的业务含义和计算方式。
say.note: Claude 会给出包含公式、单位、排除项的详细说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you write schema.yml documentation for dbt models and columns, including descriptions, business rules, grain, etc., and automatically matches the existing project documentation style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "document", "describe", "description", "dbt docs", or "schema.yml", or when asked to explain business context, grain, data meaning, or business rules.

say_en.text: Write schema.yml docs for the orders model.
say_en.note: Claude will study existing patterns first, then generate descriptions.

say_en.text: Describe the business meaning and calculation of the revenue column.
